### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**10** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via helpText (literal, a string literal in INLINE_KEYS))_
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via helpText (literal, a string literal in INLINE_KEYS))_
- `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx`  _(via ActionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/frontend/architecture-overview.mdx`  _(via ActionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/frontend/troubleshooting.mdx`  _(via ActionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ActionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ActionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d955821c288e547441f7b1171c322cfe03a7e42c` — the merge of head `ab80f700cd15a49694ed96485b167b09c0598615` into base `b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d955821c288e547441f7b1171c322cfe03a7e42c && git checkout d955821c288e547441f7b1171c322cfe03a7e42c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf ab80f700cd15a49694ed96485b167b09c0598615 && git checkout -B drift-repro b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf && git merge --no-ff ab80f700cd15a49694ed96485b167b09c0598615

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b5e7ba55521394c6a0156fc26c26d336bed0f2bf` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7b59669918a5f84a79c14fbbc509d1e9e494004e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts

Inputs read: card #29248 (body, triage 6575512138, claim 6576402352, os-dev-report 6578161293), PR #29369 (body, 10-file list, net diff against merge base `27c1c555`), the check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (changeset, regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/{action,component}.mdx`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, the three spec test files, the lint test file) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read to judge the `hits` file, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`InlineActionSchema` picks `description: true`** — RIGHT. It is `actionObject()`'s own field (`actionCopy('description')`: the ADR-0032 `template` slot with the inline locale-map arm), so the describe text, the parse envelope (`string` → `{ dialect: 'template', source }`), the blank arm and the shape refusals are shared, not restated. The strict object still refuses `icon`, `variant`, `body`, `cancelText`, `submitText` (CONTROL rows in `inline-action.test.ts`). Executes the card's ask and the cloud#3281 ruling-A sequencing (spec half first).
- **Public surface** — `InlineAction` and `InlineActionParsed` gain the optional key by derivation; no new export, so `api-surface/ui.json` is correctly untouched. `authorable-surface/ui.json` gains `ui/InlineAction:description` (the only authorable-key artifact that moves; `authorable-surface.base.json` is the merge-base deletion anchor and correctly does not move; `authorable-defaults` has no row because the key has no default). RIGHT.
- **The pick follows the renderer, not ahead of it** — RIGHT for the string arm, read in the live tree: `elements.tsx` forwards `description: action.description` to `execute(…)`; `ActionRunner.dialogCopyOf` reduces an envelope to its text; `useConsoleActionRuntime` calls `actionDescription(objForI18n, action?.name, action?.description)`, which with no `name` returns the authored text, then `interpolate` (`dialogCopyFiller`) fills `{{ record.* }}` holes; `ActionParamDialog` draws `state.description` under the title. The docblock's account matches the code.
- **The locale-map arm is a declared window** — RIGHT as stated, with its cost named here: `useActionTextLocalizer`'s `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` is `confirmText | successMessage | errorMessage`, so an inline `{ en, "zh-CN" }` on `description` is not collapsed; `dialogCopyOf` passes a non-envelope through unchanged; `actionDescription(…, undefined, map)` returns the map; `fillTransitionalCopy` regex-tests a non-string and hands it to the legacy evaluator (read, not run: the dialog shows a coerced object or its generic line, never the authored sentence). The same gap already exists for a registered action's locale-map `description` on `main`, so this PR introduces no new failure class; it widens the audience of an existing one and says so in the docblock, the changeset and the PR body. Card #29249 (`pm:blocked` on this card) is the close.
- **Lint `INLINE_KEYS` gains `description`** — RIGHT and necessary: `judgeAction(…, INLINE_KEYS, true)` now judges an inline `description` (string and each `.locale` of a map) with `actionConfirmTemplateRoots` (`record`, plus `params` only when static), `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`, `validateExpression('template')` and the blank check, each an error at `… (element:button) · action description[.locale]`. Without it the describe text that renders into the InlineAction reference table ("named and refused at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate") would be declared and not enforced (Prime Directive 10). A rule and its gate, landed as one change.
- **Forward-parity owed set grows 12 → 13 for `element:button`** — holds by reading: `elements.tsx` already forwards the key. Note the `Lint UI` check-run (which carries `check:action-forward-parity`) was SKIPPED on this head by its paths filter (no `ui/**` change), so this judgment rests on the read, not on a check-run; the dev's local exit 0 is their account.
- **Cross-reference walk (`stack.zod.ts` `collectInlinePageActions`)** parses with `InlineActionSchema` and reads only `type`/`name`/`target`: unaffected. RIGHT that nothing else moves.
- **Regenerated references** (`action.mdx`, `component.mdx`): one `description` row each in the InlineAction tables, text identical to `ActionSchema`'s describe — consistent with a shared field.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/29248-inline-action-description.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/lint: minor`. RIGHT. `Metadata-protocol: added` (a new authorable key) takes at least `minor` on every package the diff moves; lint moves (new refusals reach texts the schema refused on `main`, so no previously valid document is refused — not a narrowing).
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` — RIGHT: every body `InlineActionSchema` accepted on `main` still parses to the same output; the inline surface accepts strictly more. Both declaration lines are line-initial in the PR body and the changeset body; the `Check Changeset` check-run is `success`.
- No `skip-changeset`, no BREAKING arm, no ADR-0087 disposition owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6578161293: `open_questions: []`, six deviations, two out-of-scope findings. Each answered:

- *File surface widened to `packages/lint`* — accepted: the claim 6576402352 names the two lint files in its File surface and the reason; ① above confirms the rule/gate pairing. No escalation.
- *In-place `bodyExtra` docblock correction* — measured true in the live tree (`elements.tsx` forwards `bodyExtra: action.bodyExtra`). Comment only. Answered.
- *Forced test edits* (`INLINE_FIELDS`, the ActionSchema round-trip body, the flipped inline pin moved to its own `describe`) — each pinned the pick this card changes; the "does NOT widen" header now lists two things and points to `inline-action.test.ts`. Answered.
- *Final-head re-run narrowed to the three touched spec files + typecheck + 103 gates* — the last commit is test-only; the head's own check-runs are the gate verdicts (pending, below). Answered.
- *Full `ui/` suites left to CI* — `Test UI` (16 shards) in progress at review time. Pending, not a flag.
- *No PR assignee/reviewer* — standing order; no action.
- *Out-of-scope: `submitText` / `cancelText` not picked and not forwarded* — nothing declared that is not read; acceptance-note placement is correct under Prime Directive 10. No card owed by this PR.
- *Out-of-scope: inline refusal of `body` suggests `mode`* — pre-existing, loud; polish. No card owed by this PR.
- Escalated by this review (not a dev flag): the stale refinement comment and the follow-up question in ④ should-fix 1.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, judged against the ruling it implements (cloud#3281 ruling A, half 1 of 2 per card #29248) and its first consumer (`element:button` → `ActionRunner` → the console's param-collection handler, read in the live `ui/` tree):

- The pick is the minimal, derived change the ruling asks for; the shared-field design means the registered and inline doors cannot drift (pinned: same path, same code on a bad shape). Attempts to break it: a non-string value is refused inline as on `ActionSchema`; `confirmText` + `params` on an inline action still parses (as on `main`; see should-fix 1); a `${…}` or blank inline sentence parses (the slot's blank arm, as on a registered action) and is now refused at the doors by the lint half; a locale map parses and reaches the dialog unresolved (the declared window, ①). Nothing silent was found that the docblock does not state.
- The docblock's "widen when a renderer widens, not before" rule is honoured for the string arm and consciously bent for the map arm with the direction stated ("spec accepts ahead of the renderer, never the reverse"), the same discipline the `bodyExtra` precedent set and the card's own ordering requires.

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix 1** (`action.zod.ts`, the `confirmText`-beside-`params` refinement comment, around the line "The same holds for {@link InlineActionSchema} … and which does not pick `description`, so the remedy below has no slot there to move into"): false on this head. The inline pick now carries `description`, so the remedy slot exists inline too. Correct the comment in place (comment only; the sibling stale `bodyExtra` paragraph in the same file was corrected by this PR, this one was missed). It also raises a design question this PR correctly does not answer: whether the inline shape should now carry the same two-dialogs refusal — that is a `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on its own card, not a rider here.

**Should-fix 2** (carried to #29249, not this diff): the ui half must add `description` to `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` in `useActionTextLocalizer.ts`; until it lands an inline locale-map `description` reaches the dialog as a non-string (①). Cloud should author the string arm (or wait for #29249) when it adds `description` to `INVITE_ACTION`.

`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts` (widened in): one array entry plus two corrected comments; the judge, roots and message builders are the registered ones. Paths and severities match the new test's expectations by reading. Holds.

**Check-runs on the head at review time** — `success`: Auto Label, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Build UI Deps, Build Docs, Type Check · source gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped (query-options erasure, tooling self-tests, slot lookup & corpus), Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Flag docs affected, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size. `in_progress` (PENDING, not judged): Test Core (8 shards), Test UI (16 shards), Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint · ESLint. `skipped` by filter: Lint UI (see ① on forward parity), Temporal Conformance, UI Published Artifacts, Dogfood Verify CLI, packed-tarball smoke, 18.x harness. No check-run has failed. The verdict below is a design verdict; landing still waits for the required set to conclude `success`.

Head-sha: `ab80f700cd15a49694ed96485b167b09c0598615` · read 2026-11-02T14:05Z

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面上内联声明的动作（`element:button` 的 `properties.action`）现在可以写 `description`，也就是参数对话框标题下的那行说明。`os validate` / 发布门对它的检查与已注册动作一致。
- 为什么改：您在 cloud#3281 裁定 A，先放宽上游契约。「邀请成员」对话框现在只显示通用提示，说不清邀请会发生什么；没有这个键，云端没有地方写这句话。
- 风险与回滚：纯放宽，旧元数据全部照常通过，只多接受一个键，其余未选的键（`icon`、`variant`、`body`、`cancelText`、`submitText`）仍被拒。已知缺口：控制台还没把内联的多语言 map 折成当前语言，等 UI 半张卡 #29249。在那之前云端请写纯字符串。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（`InlineActionSchema` 的 pick 和上方注释），`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`（`INLINE_KEYS`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/inline-action.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：可落地。契约复审在 7b596699 判 PASS（6578506913），在现 head 的 delta 判 PASS（6578630622），CI 全绿。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec#2` · head `ab80f700`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29248`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` sit at line start in the body and the changeset (`@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/lint` minor). There are 10 files, all inside the claim's surface as amended in 6576402352 (the lint file was added by the seat). No governed path. +208/−32.
2. **Premise measured:** on `main`, `InlineActionSchema`'s pick has no `description`, so a strict inline action carrying it is refused. The new `inline-action.test.ts` group parses it on the head, and its CONTROL rows still refuse `icon`, `variant`, `body`, `cancelText` and `submitText`. The renderer path (`elements.tsx` → `ActionRunner` → `useConsoleActionRuntime` → `ActionParamDialog`) already forwards and draws the key; the review read this in the live tree.
3. **Gates:** `ci-failure.mjs --sha ab80f700…` GREEN, 65 check-runs, none failed, none superseded. Skipped by paths filter: Lint UI, Dogfood Verify CLI, UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x harness, schedule gate. `check:action-forward-parity` (inside Lint UI) did not run because no `ui/**` file changed; the review judged forward parity by reading the code.
4. **Accepted deviations:** the forced test edits in `inline-action.test.ts` (`INLINE_FIELDS`) and `action-description.test.ts` (the inline-refusal pin this card removes) pinned the old pick and are named in the body. The should-fix-1 comment correction (`ab80f700`) is comment-only, as verified in the delta record.
5. **Out of scope:** the locale-map arm needs `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` in `useActionTextLocalizer.ts`, carried on #29249 (note 6578561587). Whether the inline door should refuse `confirmText` beside `params` is a narrowing question, filed as #29383. `Skills-docs: none` is right: only generated reference tables list the inline key set, and they are regenerated here.
6. **Landing:** not Tier H and under 3000 lines, so the seat lands it with `pr_ready` + auto-merge. After merge, the seat writes a landing note on #29248, removes `pm:dispatched`, and lifts #29249's `Blocked-by`.
